title: Scrum Master
summary: Scrum Masters help a software team plan and deliver work in short cycles called sprints, by running the team's meetings, tracking progress and clearing blockers. They sit inside one or two delivery teams alongside the product owner and do not manage people directly.
dailyDuties: Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives
Keep the Jira or Azure DevOps board and backlog up to date
Track velocity and burndown and share sprint status
Remove blockers and manage dependencies with other teams
Coach the team and product owner on Scrum practices

skills.expectation: Run sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives
Coach the team and product owner on Scrum practices as a servant leader
Track velocity, burndown and cycle time and use them to improve delivery
Keep boards, backlogs and dashboards in Jira or Azure DevOps up to date
Manage dependencies and keep product, QA and other teams informed
Facilitate meetings and report sprint status clearly
Find and remove impediments that block the team
Work in a SAFe release train and take part in PI planning
Understand release pipelines and deployment readiness
Pull delivery data with JQL or SQL

certifications.why: Scrum Master certification most often named in Indian postings
Helps when the role also covers project delivery
